title: V-CRISP Synthetic Discrete-Event Assembly Benchmark
description: Code and data for a synthetic assembly benchmark. Includes Python and C++ checker runs, a targeted checker/guard mismatch test, and a separate MuJoCo planar reaching experiment. The MuJoCo experiment does not execute V-CRISP or model a physical assembly cell. Source code is licensed under Apache-2.0. Generated records and publication figures are licensed under CC-BY-4.0. The unpublished manuscript is not included.
